Package com.openvireo.core

package com.openvireo.core
The binding itself, generated by UniFFI from the ov-ffi crate: OvClient, Account, Vault, ServiceAccount, SelfHosted, the records and enums they take and return, the Host interfaces (HttpTransport, SecureStore, BlobCache, Clock, LogSink), OvException and the free functions (crypto, share links, TOTP, OPAQUE). Network and disk calls are suspend functions; from Java, use the wrappers in com.openvireo.core.java.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.openvireo.core.hosts
    Ready-made Host parts and defaultHost(...), so a program needs no glue: JavaNetHttpTransport, UrlConnectionTransport, MemoryStore, FileCache, MemoryCache, SystemClock, JulLogSink.
    com.openvireo.core.java
    The API for Java, without coroutines: J<Object> wrappers (JOvClient, JAccount, JVault, ...) whose suspend methods return CompletableFuture, JOv (every free function as a static), JRecords (records with unsigned fields), JErrors, and the future-based Host interfaces with JHosts and JDefaultHosts.
